assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The service appealed is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry)
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The concern is for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
There is a personal history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9)
There is a personal history of cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The documentation supports the medical necessity of the service
The service was requested in SilverBridge's letter
